title: Super Idol
blurb: Millions of people can sing the opening line of this and have no idea what any of it means. The song is 热爱105°C的你, roughly Loving You at 105°C, recorded by the Chinese singer A Si, and it went global in 2021 after a Douyin video of a young man grinning straight into the camera while performing it crossed over to TikTok. The hook opens with the words Super Idol, hence the nickname. Fifteen seconds of unstoppable cheer. It turns up in Roblox videos, gaming montages and any edit that wants sugar poured over it.
origin: The opening hook of the Chinese song 热爱105°C的你 by A Si, viral worldwide from 2021.
